absences: Synchronous calls: none made by the registry in its files (Registry.java, RegistryREST.java, RegistryStartup.java, IndexServlet.java contain no outbound client call; it only serves PUT/DELETE/GET on services/{name}/{location}).
Messages: none published or consumed in the registry files.
Registers with: nothing. It is itself the registry (RegistryREST.java:31 @Path("services")).

Telemetry: registry environment in docker-compose_kieker.yaml:45-47 sets only KIEKER_AMQP_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS, no RABBITMQ_HOST. dockerbase Dockerfile:31 defaults RABBITMQ_HOST unset and :30 LOG_TO_FILE false; start.sh:39-41 then sets kieker.monitoring.enabled=false. So no trace, metric or log destination is configured for this service in these files. Log output goes through slf4j-simple (registry pom.xml:61), destination not stated in these files.
Health check: none in the compose block (docker-compose_kieker.yaml:41-49) or in the registry/dockerbase Dockerfiles.
Client-side heartbeat sender interval: not in these files (clients are other services).
